content.value: Recall one episode in your life in which you feel you have made a decision (15) rationally. Describe how you arrived at your decision and fit your decision and fit your decision making process with the theoretical model of rational decision making process. (Hint: Choosing a Major, A place of live, A Brand of Bicycle to Buy)
